name: Camping am Badsee
beschreibung: The campsite Camping am Badsee is located near Lake Badsee. It offers generous pitches for tents, motorhomes and caravans. The Badsee lake is directly adjacent and ideal for swimming and water activities. The campsite is equipped with modern sanitary facilities and electric hookups. The surrounding region is wonderfully suited for hiking, cycling tours and watersports, serving as an ideal base for local exploration.
